packages.name: @velajs/vela
packages.summary: Checked dependency injection, schema-bound HTTP endpoints and live queries, immutable verified identity, typed context boundaries, and read-only live inspection. Existing provider, context, lazy-loader, and live APIs require migration.

packages.name: @velajs/errors
packages.summary: Coordinated Vela 2.0 toolchain and package release. The standalone error behavior is unchanged.

packages.name: @velajs/live-protocol
packages.summary: Shared runtime argument/result parsers and validated live frame contracts used by the server and every client.

packages.name: @velajs/better-auth
packages.summary: Native environment configuration and one immutable verified identity shared with provider-independent authorization.

packages.name: @velajs/authz
packages.summary: Provider-independent authorization consumes the shared verified identity, including tenant and expiry checks.

packages.name: @velajs/cloudflare-access
packages.summary: Cloudflare Access authentication integrated with the shared Vela identity and authorization contracts.

packages.name: @velajs/cloudflare
packages.summary: Native binding tokens, per-environment application lifetime, environment-created module graphs, isolated live drivers, and Durable Object live inspection. Includes a complete D1/auth/CRUD/live/Studio starter.

packages.name: @velajs/cli
packages.summary: Schema-driven Hono client generation and the local Vela Studio host command. Generated contracts preserve unknown types where a response schema is absent.

packages.name: @velajs/feature-flags
packages.summary: Parser-backed flag values and the checked Vela provider contracts.

packages.name: @velajs/testing
packages.summary: Typed override descriptors and production-equivalent request and environment scope.

packages.name: @velajs/storage
packages.summary: Native Workers bindings and checked schema boundaries; validated against real workerd bindings.

packages.name: @velajs/react-native
packages.summary: React Native bindings aligned with the Vela 2.0 client and shared live contracts.

packages.name: @velajs/client
packages.summary: Upstream Hono HTTP client exports and schema-validated live snapshots, deltas, hydration, optimistic updates and rollback.

packages.name: @velajs/react
packages.summary: Query-isolated React hooks using shared live contracts and the Vela 2.0 client.

packages.name: @velajs/crud
packages.summary: Schema-bound resources and hooks, compound cursor pagination, explicit adapter capabilities, and honest shaped output boundaries.

packages.name: @velajs/crud-memory
packages.summary: Memory adapter aligned with Vela 2.0 CRUD contracts and compound cursor conformance.

packages.name: @velajs/crud-drizzle
packages.summary: Typed Drizzle adapter and native D1 conformance. Unsupported D1 callback transactions fail before side effects.

packages.name: @velajs/studio-ui
packages.summary: Initial coordinated release: packaged Studio interface, standalone assets, model browser, API try-it, and live/presence panels.

packages.name: @velajs/studio-host
packages.summary: Initial coordinated release: loopback Studio host with separate host, admin and application request credentials.

packages.name: @velajs/studio
packages.summary: Initial coordinated release: authenticated admin operations, checked wire schemas, native Worker try-it boundaries, and opt-in read-only live/presence inspection.

packages.name: @velajs/studio-protocol
packages.summary: Initial coordinated release of the Studio operation catalog, capabilities and response schemas.
